description: This file contains CSS styles for managing themes (light and dark) in a Tic Tac Toe application, along with responsive design elements.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application styling including text alignment, background color, and transitions for dark and light themes.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Styling for the application header section with flexbox layout for centered content.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Styling for links in the application using theme colors.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Styling for the theme toggle button to switch between light and dark themes.
